newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end mixed, bonds fail to hold gains.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end mixed, bonds fail to hold gains.

text.p: Oct 8 - U.S. debt futures ended narrowly mixed, with bonds failing to hold slim gains. Most traders expressed some disappointment with Treasury's 10-yr note sale. Avg yield for 10-yrs was at 6.5 pct, in-line with expectations. But dealers became too long during the sale on beliefs of good demand. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
